```{r}
raw <- read.csv("../data/results_dev.csv", comment.char = "#",
                header = FALSE, fill = TRUE, col.names = paste0("V", 1:22),
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

base <- raw %>%
  filter(V10 == "_Trial_", V11 == "End") %>%    # one row per trial
  transmute(session_hash = V2, label = V6, order = V4,
            ReferenceCountry = V14, V15, V16, V17, V18)

religion <- base %>% filter(label == "religion") %>%
  rename(Christian = V15, Muslim = V16, NonReligious = V17, Other = V18)

race <- base %>% filter(label == "race") %>%
  rename(White = V15, Black = V16, Asian = V17, Other = V18)   # sessions 1-3: V16 is "Non-white", V17/V18 are NA/NULL

region <- base %>% filter(label == "region") %>%
  rename(Asia = V15, Africa = V16, MiddleEast = V17, Europe = V18)
```

```{r}
times <- d %>%
  mutate(EventTime = as.numeric(EventTime)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(EventTime)) %>%
  group_by(MD5.hash.of.participant.s.IP.address) %>%
  summarise(minutes = (max(EventTime) - min(EventTime)) / 1000 / 60)

mean(times$minutes)
median(times$minutes)
summary(times$minutes)
hist(times$minutes, breaks = 20)
```


```{r}
# Assign participant number
d$Participant <- as.integer(factor(d$MD5.hash.of.participant.s.IP.address))
length(unique(d$Participant))
length(unique(d$Parameter))

# Separate out demographic information
demo <- d %>% 
    filter((Label == "demo") &
             (!Parameter %in% c("_Trial_","_Header_"))) %>% 
    dplyr::select(Participant,Parameter,Value) %>% 
    pivot_wider(
        names_from = Parameter,
        values_from = Value,
        names_prefix = "Demo_"
      )

d.sub <- d %>% 
    filter((Label == "test") &
             (PennElementType == "Scale")) %>% 
    dplyr::select(Participant,Label,Value,TrialNumber,TrialType,Word) %>% 
    rename(Response = Value)


View(demo)

df_combined <- full_join(demo, d.sub, by = "Participant")

# Collapse List-columns, 
# convert c(3, 4, 5) to "3;4;5"
df_combined <- df_combined |>
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.list),
                       ~ sapply(., paste, collapse = ";")))

df_combined <- full_join(val,df_combined, by = "Word")
```


```{r}

# Write to .csv not aggregating over participants
write.csv(df_combined,"../data/processed.csv")

```
